breakdown.description: Prandtl number value is inconsistent with the stated fluid (air at 25 C does not have Pr≈7).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The ground truth correctly identifies that a Prandtl number of 7.0 is wrong for air at 25 C and suggests correcting either the fluid or the Pr value. The generated specification ignored this physical impossibility and repeated the user's incorrect instruction to "Use air at 25°C with Prandtl number Pr = 7.0."
